function calculate()
            local countMap = {}
            for _, number in ipairs(realShowPhotoSidOneList) do
                if countMap[number] then
                    countMap[number] = countMap[number] + 1
                else
                    countMap[number] = 1
                end
            end

            local countArray = {}
            for number, count in pairs(countMap) do
                table.insert(countArray, {number = number, count = count})
            end

            -- 按出现次数从高到低排序
            table.sort(countArray, function(a, b)
                return a.count > b.count
            end)

            -- 分别存储排序后的数字和出现次数
            local sortedNumbers = {}
            local sortedCounts = {}

            for _, entry in ipairs(countArray) do
                table.insert(sortedNumbers, entry.number)
                table.insert(sortedCounts, entry.count)
            end
            return #sortedNumbers, sortedNumbers[1], sortedNumbers[2], sortedNumbers[3]
          end
